{{Quote|From Lieutenant Jez Planchet. He recruited me about six months ago. Gave me orders to bring you a message&mdash;and then report for duty. I'm ready to serve the Rebel Alliance, wherever I'm needed.|X-7, posing as S'ree Bonard, to an Alliance guard|<ref name="Target" />}}
'''Jez Planchet''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Planchet went on a deep covert [[Mission to Malastare (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] without being able to transmit to the Alliance. He was captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and underwent a long period of [[Torture/Legends|torture]] before eventually breaking. Planchet revealed everything he knew about the Rebels before being [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Lieutenant Planchet's been deep undercover on Malastare for the last year.|X-7, posing as S'ree Bonard|<ref name="Target" />}}
[[File:MalastareNEGAS.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Malastare, where Jez Planchet went undercover]]
Jez Planchet was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Target" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> Planchet was given a secret, undercover [[Mission to Malastare (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. Due to the nature of his assignment, Planchet had no direct communication to his allies and was completely cut off from them.<ref name="Target" />

At some point during his mission, Planchet was captured by the Imperials and placed in a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] cell, managing at first to stay silent when questioned by the Empire's expert interrogators. However, after a prolonged duration of [[Torture/Legends|torture]], Planchet eventually broke and divulged everything he knew about the Alliance in a plea to end the torture. After obtaining all his secrets, the Imperials [[Death/Legends|executed]] him with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot.<ref name="Target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Dates" /> a few [[Standard month|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Planchet was already dead when the Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]] went to the Rebel [[Great Temple/Legends|base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], one of three habitable [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]], while on a mission to kill the [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|pilot]] who destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. Under the alias S'ree Bonard, he used a thumbprint and an Alliance landing code extracted from Planchet during his torture to get past a Rebel [[Unidentified Rebel Guard (Yavin 4)|guard]]. X-7 convinced the guard that Planchet had recruited him while he was undercover on Malastare, and ordered him to deliver data plans straight to Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] about a new Imperial ship.<ref name="Target" />

==Skills and abilities==
Jez Planchet was a skilled individual proficient in undercover missions. He was trusted enough by his superiors to go on a deep undercover mission to Malastare for a long period without reporting back.<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jez Planchet was mentioned in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2008]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="Target" />
